# VolitionRx Limited Announces $500,000 Partial Pre-Payment of Convertible Note in Cash


October 27, 2026 8:17am EDT[Download as PDF](https://ir.volition.com/_assets/_0f449c24db7068b80533631c7553d9d2/volitionrx/news/2026-10-27_VolitionRx_Limited_Announces_500_000_Partial_Pre_905.pdf)


- *Reduces outstanding principal to only $0.7 million on the $2.4 million note and brings total debt reduction across both notes to over $5.0 million since June 30, 2026.*
- *Secures agreement pausing conversion rights until January 2027 (unless closing share price equals or exceeds $0.275) and deferring remaining monthly repayments for 2026.*


HENDERSON, Nev.


, Oct. 27, 2026


/PRNewswire/ -- VolitionRx Limited (NYSE AMERICAN: VNRX) ("Volition"), a multi-national epigenetics company, today announces a $500,000 partial prepayment in cash towards the outstanding principal balance on its senior secured convertible promissory note, dated January 15, 2026, in the original principal amount of $2,400,000 (the "Note"), issued to Lind Global Asset Management XII LLC ("Lind"). Following the partial pre-payment, the remaining outstanding balance under the Note as of the date of this announcement is down to $706,667. As previously announced, the senior secured convertible promissory note, dated May 20, 2025, in the original principal amount of $7,500,000, also issued to Lind, was fully-satisfied by the Company in September and is no longer outstanding.


In connection with the partial prepayment, Volition and Lind entered into a waiver and consent pursuant to which (i) Lind agreed to accept such prepayment, (ii) Lind agreed not to exercise its conversion rights under the Note on or prior to January 1, 2027 unless and until the closing price per share of Volition's common stock equals or exceeds $0.275 per share, and (iii) the parties agreed to defer the otherwise required monthly repayments for each of November and December 2026 and to continue to reflect such amounts in outstanding principal until otherwise satisfied.


**Cameron Reynolds** , Chief Executive Officer, Volition, commented:


"We appreciate Lind's continued partnership and flexibility as reflected in this agreement and are very pleased to prepay a significant portion of the outstanding balance of this Note to Lind in cash well ahead of schedule. With this prepayment, we have extinguished over $5.0 million across both notes since June 30th, and we expect to have the remaining Note fully-satisfied well in advance of its maturity. We continue to execute against our plan to improve Volition's financial position and further debt and expense reduction remains a top priority as we seek to maximize stockholder value."


**About Volition**


Volition is a multi-national company focused on advancing the science of epigenetics. Volition is dedicated to saving lives and improving outcomes for people and animals with life-altering diseases through earlier detection, as well as disease and treatment monitoring.


Through its subsidiaries, Volition is developing and commercializing simple, easy to use, cost-effective blood tests to help detect and monitor a range of diseases, including some cancers and diseases associated with NETosis, such as sepsis. Early detection and monitoring have the potential not only to prolong the life of patients, but also to improve their quality of life.
